title: The Color Purple
author: Alice Walker
engineRationale: Period literary fiction rooted in a specific place and era (rural Georgia, 1900s-1940s) with named, vividly depictable characters (Celie, Shug Avery, Nettie, Mister, Sofia) and concrete documentary settings — farmhouses, cotton fields, juke joints, letters, mission Africa. Photoreal Flux cut-outs of period figures fit far better than an abstract everyman rig; same call as Little Women.
